source.title: Asha Learning Grant — demo handbook
source.notice: An authored, fictional handbook for testing this app. No real scholarship or application service is offered.

sections.title: §1 · Who this demonstration describes
sections.text: The fictional Asha Learning Grant supports first-year undergraduate students. This demonstration does not collect applications or decide anyone’s eligibility.

sections.title: §2 · Provisional applications
sections.text: Students awaiting final results may apply with their latest available marksheet. Final results must be uploaded by 30 September 2026.

sections.title: §3 · Documents
sections.text: The demo application checklist contains a latest available marksheet, an admission offer, and a one-page statement of study plans. Do not upload identity documents, bank details, or personal records to this demonstration.

sections.title: §4 · Submission
sections.text: In this fictional example, the application and study statement are submitted together through the grant portal by 15 September 2026. There is no application fee. No real grant portal exists for this demonstration.

sections.title: §5 · Review and clarification
sections.text: A human grant coordinator reviews applications. Receiving guidance does not guarantee an award. If the handbook does not answer a question, ask the coordinator instead of inventing a rule.
